definitions.gloss: shoe blister; chafing from shoes; shoe sore
definitions.explanation: A blister, sore, or abrasion on the foot caused by friction from ill-fitting or new shoes. A common problem when breaking in new footwear.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{靴|くつ}で{靴擦|くつず}れができた。
examples.english: I got a blister from my new shoes.

examples.japanese: {靴擦|くつず}れが{痛|いた}くて{歩|ある}けない。
examples.english: The shoe blister hurts so much that I can't walk.

examples.japanese: {靴擦|くつず}れを{防|ふせ}ぐために、{新|あたら}しい{靴|くつ}は{少|すこ}しずつ{履|は}き{慣|な}らした{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: To prevent blisters, it's better to gradually break in new shoes.

notes:
USAGE:
A very practical, everyday word. Most commonly occurs with {新|あたら}しい{靴|くつ} (new shoes) or {革靴|かわぐつ} (leather shoes). Blisters typically form on the heel or sides of the foot.

FORMATION:
{靴|くつ} (shoes) + {擦|ず}れ (rubbing, chafing — from the verb {擦|す}れる).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴擦|くつず}れができる (to get a shoe blister)
- {靴擦|くつず}れを{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent shoe blisters)
- {靴擦|くつず}れ{防止|ぼうし}パッド (blister prevention pad)
- {靴|くつ}を{履|は}き{慣|な}らす (to break in shoes)
